changes.title: One logbook on all your phones
changes.body: With the online backup, every phone signed in to the same account now shares one logbook: trips recorded on your iPhone and on an Android phone show up on both, and a change made on one phone reaches the others.

changes.title: A light look
changes.body: Settings has a new Look choice: Dark, as before, or Light, with white tiles on a warm page.

changes.title: The truck and today's trips on Home
changes.body: Home now shows whether your truck is connected, when your Shortcuts automation last said so, and a list of today's finished trips.

changes.title: Monthly reminder and daily check
changes.body: Dually can remind you each month to send last month's report until you do, and can tell you on a work day when no trip was recorded. Both are in Settings.

changes.title: Each day its own hours
changes.body: Work hours can now be set for each day of the week on its own, for a day that starts or ends at a different time.

changes.title: More report choices
changes.body: The report can cover a month, any date range or a whole year, can list Personal trips and the odometer of each trip, and keeps a list of the reports you have sent. After a month is sent, Dually offers to delete its GPS points to free space.

changes.title: The Log
changes.body: Settings has a link to the Log: every trip, every message from your Shortcuts automation and every error, day by day, with a button to share the whole log.

changes.title: A graph of the year
changes.body: Trips has a new Graph of the year: your Business and Personal distance for each month, side by side, with each month's figures under it.

changes.title: Email support and a review
changes.body: The end of Settings has Email support, which starts an email to us with your version of Dually and your iPhone's model at the end, and a link to review Dually on the App Store.

changes.title: What's new
changes.body: This list. It opens by itself once after each update, and any time from the Version tile at the end of Settings.

changes.title: Dually on the iPhone
changes.body: The first version on the App Store. A Shortcuts automation on CarPlay or your truck's Bluetooth starts and ends each trip, Dually records it with GPS and sorts it into Business or Personal by your work hours, and each month it makes the report for your accountant.

changes.title: On the Lock Screen, in CarPlay and on the Home Screen
changes.body: The trip being recorded shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, CarPlay has its own screen with Start and End, and a widget shows the trip and your month at a glance.

changes.title: Optional online backup
changes.body: Buy it once (no subscription) and your trips are copied to Google's Firebase, in its Montréal data centre in Canada. Everything else is free, with no ads.
